title: Grandmother Holding Baby Sharon, 1946 Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: 448 Sharon & Grandmother Mabel Phillips Jane & Crawford mother April 1946
description: A post-WWII family snapshot from April 1946 depicting an elderly woman, identified on the back as Mabel Phillips, holding her infant granddaughter Sharon. Mabel is dressed in a smart 1940s suit jacket with a decorative brooch, white ruffled collar, and eyeglasses, while baby Sharon wears a wide-brim bonnet and knitted sweater dress. They stand outdoors in front of a Spanish Colonial Revival style arched doorway bearing the house number 163.
